description: The single authoritative register of shared security and solver limits. Every value is a policy ceiling or floor that PHP, Rust and the browser must enforce identically: a drift in any one implementation is a fleet-visible split (a solve the browser mints but a server refuses, or a key PHP accepts and Rust rejects). tools/ci/limits-parity-check.sh reads each implementation's own constant declarations and fails on ANY pairwise difference with this manifest, exactly like the execution-v1 register gate. Update this file deliberately, then every implementation in the same change.
